discarded-may-advance.why: A withdrawn record may advance again, so a policy raised in error can be walked to ISSUED — the state docs/discard.md exists to make impossible. discard.e2e-spec.ts dies. REPOINTED: the original anchor spanned three lines including `const discardedAt = (current as { discardedAt?: Date | null }).discardedAt;`, and PRETTIER later wrapped that expression across two lines, so the anchor stopped matching while the code was unchanged. A one-line anchor cannot be broken by a reflow — the same lesson as the rendered-identifier detector, whose sixth blind spot was introduced by a reformat rather than by code.
